messages.subject: read.bismark error
parts:
Hi Y'all

Can someone please help me figure out what these errors are all about?  I'm running R on Stampede on TACC.  Here is what I'm getting: 

> library("methylKit")

> file.list=list( system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FV1.sam", package = "methylKit"),

+                 system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FV2.sam", package = "methylKit"),

+                 system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FV3.sam", package = "methylKit"),

+                 system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FE1.sam", package = "methylKit"),

+                 system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FE2.sam", package = "methylKit"),

+                 system.file("/scratch/02408/bnugent/WGBS/BAM/BAM", "FE3.sam", package = "methylKit"))

> # read the files to a methylRawList object: myobj

> myobj=read.bismark(location="file.list"

+              ,sample.id=list("F1","F2","F3","E1", "E2", "E3"),assembly="rn5",

+              save.folder=NULL,save.context=NULL,read.context="CpG",

+              nolap=FALSE,mincov=10,minqual=20,phred64=FALSE,treatment=c(0,0,0,1,1,1))

Error in (function (classes, fdef, mtable)  : 

  unable to find an inherited method for function ‘read.bismark’ for signature ‘"character", "list", "character"’

> myobj=read.bismark(location=file.list 

+              ,sample.id=list("F1","F2","F3","E1", "E2", "E3"),assembly="rn5",

+              save.folder=NULL,save.context=NULL,read.context="CpG",

+              nolap=FALSE,mincov=10,minqual=20,phred64=FALSE,treatment=c(0,0,0,1,1,1))

Error in .local(location, sample.id, assembly, save.folder, save.context,  : 

  File supplied as the 'location' argument doesn't exist

can not find file at:


As you can see, whether or not I have " "'s around file.list produces a different error.  I just need to know how to remedy this situation and get the files read in!!!  I've tried to investigate how the function read.bismark works, but its over my head at this point.  I've been trying to get this to work for two days, and its beyond my comprehension!! Please help!!!


Bridget

At this point, I am not able to dissect the reason for error message. However, you may try the following:

1. Sam file supplied to bismark doesn't need lines starting with "@". So, try removing them. Previously, this was well explained the Altuna, author of methylkit in this forum.
2. Try the following command on a sample file 

mydata<-read.bismark("sorted_sam_file_path",sample.id="sample_id",assembly="Dp")

Regards,
Kalyan

parts:
Hi everyone!
thank you Kalyan for your help. I solved my problem and was able to read in my .sam files. I realised that didn't remove the .sam header (@) in the first place, so this a simple command to do it for people who encountered the same problem:
grep -v "^@" S myfile.sam > myfile_noHead.sam

Also, after that, I had problems to make the "unite" function work. I realised working on a non-model organism, that the "|" after each scaffold names, caused a shit while reading my sam file. The size of the scaffold was then read as the base position, and read by unite as duplicated position for each line reporting the same scaffold. so this is how I fixed it:
sed 's/|/_/g' myfile_noHead.sam > myfile_noHead_Underscore.sam

This works well, but it takes some computing time in UNIX/linux, so if anyone thinks of a better way to do it, great.

From then you can go on with the read.bismark function.

hope it helps the community!

@Kalyan: I can see from the help that read.bismark doesn't have a mc.cores option, you think that would still work? the computation time is high to read the .sam files, so I was wondering if there was a way (aside from having more cluster power...) to make it faster.

Thanks again, the google group is a great thing!

Leni
